defs.def: happening immediately 立即的；立刻的

ex.s: Instantly, eyes turned to me with newfound interest and curiosity.
ex.t: 顿时，一双双眼睛带着新的兴趣和好奇转向我。

ex.s: But when he looked to the side, he saw instantly that it wasn’t a dog at all, but a wolf, quickly catching up with him.
ex.t: 但当他看着侧面时，他立刻看到它根本不是一只狗，而是一只狼，很快赶上了他。

ex.s: Li Ning 19, Shanghai, China I celebrated my 18th birthday just before I went to university.I expected to feel instantly different, as if I had closed the door on my childhood and stepped into a whole new adult world.
ex.t: 19岁的李宁，中国上海我在上大学前刚刚庆祝了我的18岁生日。我期待着立刻感觉不同，仿佛我已经关上了童年的大门，踏入了一个全新的成人世界。

ex.s: Channels of communication, such as the mobile phone and the Internet, have made it possible to speak instantly with someone on the other side of the planet, enabling us to form close connections with people of completely different cultures.
ex.t: 移动电话和互联网等沟通渠道使我们能够与地球另一端的人即时交谈，使我们能够与完全不同文化的人建立密切联系。

defs.def: that can be made quickly and easily, usually by adding hot water 食物
a very short period of time 瞬间；片刻

ex.s: The intricately fashioned objects that have stood still for centuries instantly come back to life: water flows, boats sail, dogs bark, chickens flap their wings and a woman starts to spin.
ex.t: 那些历经数百年静止不动的、制作精巧的物品，瞬间焕发了生机：水流了起来，船划了起来，狗叫了起来，鸡扇动着翅膀，一个女人开始纺纱。

ex.s: Maybe you won’t.” In an instant, a woman raced into my house and left happily with the vase.
ex.t: “也许你不会要。”顷刻间，一位女士冲进我家，高高兴兴地拿着花瓶离开了。

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

defs.def: a particular point in time 某一时刻

ex.s: Your lights will come on the instant you enter the door along with your favourite music or TV programmes, and you will find your dinner already prepared for you.
ex.t: 你一进门，灯就会亮起，你最喜欢的音乐或电视节目就会开始播放，你会发现晚餐已经为你准备好了。

ex.s: She ceased her struggle the instant I picked her up.
ex.t: 我一把她抱起来，她就停止了挣扎。
